instruction: Add a formula in cell E1 that counts the total number of papers (data rows excluding header) in the spreadsheet.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a formula to count papers. Currently there is 1 data row (row 2 with QWEN paper), so the expected count is 1. Verified by reading the Excel file which shows row 2 has data and row 3 is empty.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator checks formula result (value=1) but not formula existence - using data_only=True in openpyxl returns evaluated values, not formulas
Cannot distinguish between hard-coded value '1' vs. a formula that evaluates to 1 (e.g., =COUNTA(A2:A100) or =1 or =2-1)
Cannot verify the formula logic matches instruction requirement (counting data rows) - only checks final numeric result
Instruction requires 'Add a formula that counts...', but evaluator would pass even if user manually types '1' without any formula
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Getter should use data_only=False in openpyxl.load_workbook() to read formula strings instead of evaluated results
Getter should return ws[cell].value which will be the formula string (e.g., '=COUNTA(A2:A100)') not the result
Metric should verify: (1) cell contains a formula (starts with '='), (2) formula uses COUNT/COUNTA function, (3) formula evaluates to expected count
Alternative: Split into two checks - one to verify formula existence/type (string matching), another to verify the evaluated result equals expected count
